title: Meet Maniamma, The 74-Year-Old Grandma Who Holds 12 Driving Licences, Drives Car, Buses And Cranes | Viral News - News18
text: A healthy marriage isn’t built on love alone; it thrives on mutual support, personal growth and the shared pursuit of new skills. When partners encourage each other to learn and evolve, they not only strengthen their bond but also help one another become their best selves. A wonderful example of this is 74-year-old Radhamani, better known as Maniamma, who has captured hearts with her remarkable driving skills that she learned from her husband. 74-Year-Old Woman Can Drive A Crane The Kerala native, who was once afraid to drive, worked diligently to build her confidence and master the skill. Today, she can even handle large vehicles like buses and cranes. Her remarkable determination, combined with her husband’s continuous support, helped her achieve this inspiring milestone. Speaking to SheThePeople, the elderly shared her story about how she developed her passion for driving and said, “My husband was constantly encouraging. A few years into our marriage, we purchased a car at home to provide taxi service. In 1981, after my husband’s persistent efforts, I decided to learn to drive. Initially, I was afraid of hitting someone. But with his help, I got better with practice. I quickly improved my driving skills to the point that I could drive a bus." This passion for cars and vehicles led the couple to start a driving school business, through which they also issued heavy vehicle licences. Even after her husband’s passing in 2004, Maniamma refused to give up on his dream. She continues to train at the driving school, keeping his memory and their shared passion alive. “My parents had no idea about any of this; it was my spouse who constantly encouraged me, but he died in an accident in 2004. It was devastating for me. He was everything to me, but I never gave up on his ambition; instead, I decided to pursue it, and as time passed, we purchased more vehicles to train at the driving school," she said. The 74-Year-Old Holds 12 Licences With time, Maniamma developed her skills and learned to drive several other vehicles. Today, she holds 12 driving licences, covering vehicles such as buses, trucks, lorries, tractors, forklifts, excavators, cranes, container trailer trucks, and road rollers, among others. She is also the proud owner of Kerala’s first heavy vehicle driving school. Not just this, the 74-year-old is also the oldest lady to hold this many licences, and her grandson is the youngest. Breaking the gender stereotypes about women being bad drivers, Maniamma said, “Women are widely perceived to be bad drivers. I believe this is because women have more fear in their minds, which affects their confidence. But we must change our thinking and not leave it to fate. You should control your own destiny." Maniamma serves as an inspiration to many women who are afraid to pursue their dreams.
